decisions.reason: While both studies replicate Wei et al.'s (2024) finding that integrative reading prompts improve integration quantity, the authors explicitly contrast the substantial increase in structural quality (GC_sim) at delayed writing with the absence of such an increase in Wei et al. (2024), and no overall verdict on the replication as a whole overrides this stated contrast.

shipped.title_o: The effects of reading prompts and of post-reading generative learning tasks on multiple document integration: evidence from concept network analysis
shipped.outcome_quote: Results from the two studies agree with the previous research that the quantity and structural quality of integration can be improved by external cues and by delayed repeated writing.
